notes: The runner keeps the env alive for interviews after simulation_end, so /run-status says 'running' until close-env. Read right after close-env (00:19 UTC), it said 'completed' for the new run (new started_at). The script's first pass read it before close-env; the order is fixed in force-smoke.ts and no second paid run was made.
cost_usd is the key-usage delta over the run, on a key other lanes were using at the same time, so it is an upper bound (spike S1 measured about $0.006 per round).
turn.ts: restart with POST /start {platform:'parallel', max_rounds, force:true}; detect the end from the new simulation_end line in twitter/actions.jsonl; read run-status only after close-env.
